title: Special Topics in Immersive Media; Physical Computing
description:
Prerequisite: Minimum grade of C- in CMSC131 or IMDM227.

This course explores the fundamentals of extending computation beyond your laptop and into the physical world. Physical computing refers to the design and construction of physical systems that use a mix of software and hardware to sense and respond to the surrounding world. Students will program a microcontroller to control external devices suchas lights, small motors, and electromagnets.
